ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Mars

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.
